result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The full `mvn -o test` run passes. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, so your T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1 example is not checked directly.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are filtered out as before.

The overview is the only caller of that method, so nothing else changes order.
